headline: Congress takes a breather: both chambers hold minimal sessions with reconvening set for Monday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened briefly in pro forma session on Thursday morning, lasting just 33 seconds before adjourning. No substantive business was conducted. The chamber will reconvene in pro forma session Monday.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for just four minutes on Thursday morning, adjourning immediately after opening remarks. Thirty-four bills and eight resolutions were introduced for future consideration, but no votes or substantive debate took place. The chamber is essentially in recess.
